title: 连接势途 GEO
description: 登录势途 GEO，在 Agent 接入中心创建仅授权所需客户的密钥。凭证由 WorkBuddy 保存在本机；调用业务接口时发送至势途 GEO。付费任务执行前会预估势途 GEO 积分。
description_en: Create a client-scoped Agent token in Shitu GEO. WorkBuddy stores it locally and sends it to Shitu GEO when calling its API. Paid tasks are estimated before execution.
docLabel: 查看接入指南与获取密钥
